
DESCRIPTION
Add a project from a technology stack

USAGE
  one add [template-id] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one add
  one add react-spa --name web --yes
  one add empty-app --name web --yes
  one add empty-service --name api --yes

TIPS
Add a project from a template, or start empty and configure a technology stack later. Installs missing workspace and technology-stack skills after generation; use --skip-skills to skip. Business skills are installed manually.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -n, --name <value>       Project name
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --skip-skills            Skip automatic installation of workspace and technology-stack skills
  -y, --yes                Run non-interactively
